precondition.description: The contractor supplies explicit search terms and absolute roots, then grants read-only filesystem authority attenuated to the provider-authored scope.

move.description: Search path names and file contents, rank the bounded candidates, bind every admitted source by digest and owning membrane, and report omissions without changing source territory.
move.domain: ActivityStreams Accept of one provider-authored recovery offer
move.codomain: ContextualBundle plus GapBundle or explicit refusal

postcondition.description: Every admitted source names its path, digest, ownership evidence, status, matching terms, and bounded snippets; truncation, unreadable files, and unmatched terms remain explicit gaps; customer territory is unchanged.
